stakeholders.title: Amit Bindrani — Senior General Manager, Arvind Limited
stakeholders.desc: Two decades of retail operating leadership across three major Indian formats

body.label: Career background
items: Senior General Manager, Arvind Limited — Ahmedabad, since 2023

body.label: Relevance to this engagement
body.text: Two decades of operating discipline spanning large-format, multi-brand and specialty retail — store rollout, regional sales leadership, and operations management at scale. That range of formats, from Pantaloons through Reliance Trends to Arvind, is a directly relevant lens on the store rollout and assortment decisions PlayBlue is now working through.

stakeholders.title: Satyam Trivedi — Co-founder
stakeholders.desc: Institutional sports operator. The brand-access advantage.

body.label: Track record
items: CEO, GMR Sports — cricket conglomerate across geographies (IPL, WPL, ILT20, The Hundred, PKL); created new IPs and infrastructure projects
Deputy CEO & Executive Director, RPSG Sports — franchises in India and South Africa (IPL, SA20, ISL)
Founding member and CEO, Adani Sportsline — built from the ground up (PKL, WPL, Ahmedabad Marathon)
Also associated with Ultimate Kho Kho and Big Bout Indian Boxing League

body.label: Strategic read
body.text: This is the asset that makes 100+ brand partnerships plausible at seed stage — very few Indian retail founders can open those doors. It is also a sports-industry network rather than a retail one, which is why the operating hires are being recruited from outside.

stakeholders.title: Jayam Vora — Co-founder
stakeholders.desc: Consumer and fitness operator. Most likely internal champion for consumer research.

body.label: Track record
items: Co-founder, Fitternity — India's largest fitness booking platform, 1M+ paid users, acquired by Curefit in 2021
Cult.fit leadership team; led Gold's Gym India, co-led the 300+ gym cultpass network
Investor and strategic advisor to Indian D2C brands across jewellery, personal care and perfumery
The public voice on market sizing and the retail touchpoint gap

body.label: Strategic read
body.text: Fitternity and cultpass are membership and retention businesses. That experience maps directly onto the 10M-community ambition — and means he will already have views on what a consumer data layer needs to look like. Expect a sophisticated buyer, not a persuadable one.

stakeholders.title: Mustafa Ghouse — Centre Court Capital, co-lead investor
stakeholders.desc: Sector-specialist fund with an explicit analytics thesis.

body.label: Position
items: Founder and General Partner; former professional tennis player; former CEO, JSW Sports
Closed a ₹410 Cr maiden fund in Dec 2025, oversubscribed against a ₹350 Cr target
Cheques of ₹8–24 Cr across a planned 15–18 companies; 30–40% reserved for follow-ons; leads or co-leads most deals
LP base includes Neeraj Chopra, Rishabh Pant, PV Sindhu, Jemimah Rodrigues, Binny Bansal, Mithun Sacheti, Ankit Nagori, Premji Invest and SIDBI
Portfolio: Michezo Sports (infrastructure), Quidich Innovation Labs (broadcast tech), Stupa Sports (data), Fancraze

body.label: Strategic read
body.text: His stated thesis names "infrastructure, analytics and fan-facing products." The portfolio is weighted toward data and technology rather than merchandising. A PlayBlue that can show consumer evidence rather than assertion fits that thesis; one that cannot, fits it less well. This is the most receptive audience in the room for what we do.

stakeholders.title: MIXI Global Investments and WEH Ventures
stakeholders.desc: Japanese strategic capital plus an Indian early-stage fund.

body.label: MIXI Global — Tomoharu Urabe, Managing Director
body.text: Co-lead. Public rationale centres on rising participation across age groups and, notably, parent-led youth participation — a segment PlayBlue's own materials do not name. Brings comparative format expectations from a more mature market.

body.label: Worth asking
body.text: MIXI's stated thesis flags parents buying for children. PlayBlue's public segmentation does not. Either it is a deliberate omission or an unclaimed segment — and it has very different format implications.

stakeholders.title: CFO and board — referenced but not named
stakeholders.desc: Implied by the F&A job posting. Unknown composition.

body.text: The F&A Head posting refers to "the models the board and the CFO run the business on," implying both exist. A co-led seed round typically produces investor-nominated directors. Nobody is publicly named.

body.label: Why it matters
body.text: If the buying decision routes through a CFO measuring cost per decision rather than through an operator measuring risk reduction, the framing changes materially. Worth asking early who else would be in the room.

statedGoals.text: Reach ₹100 crore in revenue and operational profitability in phase one, before the next fundraise.
Open a 15,000 sq ft flagship in Bengaluru, then expand to Mumbai and Delhi NCR.
Launch a pan-India e-commerce platform in parallel with the stores, not after them.
Bring together 100+ global and Indian brands across six categories.
Build a network of more than 150 stores over five years.
Reach ₹5,000 crore in annual revenue on a five-year horizon.
Deliver 4-hour delivery, expert in-store guidance and centralised cross-channel inventory as the core customer promise.
Build a community that goes beyond the transaction, framed around accelerating India's shift from watching sport to playing it.
Stand up a quick-commerce fulfilment operation alongside standard e-commerce delivery.
Build finance, HR, buying and brand partnership functions from zero, based in Ahmedabad.
